time_contract: Model position-measurement origin and receiver dt preserved. Donor control shifted by receiver decision minus donor decision. Before receiver decision, retain own prefix. Complete steps ending beyond decision+500ms are unsupported and excluded from ALL four conditions; supported prefix dt is unchanged. No extrapolation.
gain_contract: CA/gA, CB/gB and C/((gA+gB)/2), where gA/gB are signed time-average differential differences actually applied over each receiver [position-origin, evaluation-time]; protect abs denominator<0.02. Internal ratios, not physical gains.
support_contract: Train AUTO_stable coarse descriptor neighbors, same hardware and ratio, excluding receiver and donor flights; count flights separately. Future four-coordinate means tested against neighbors; not full-history causal support. No cases removed.
